title: Claim Deadlines and Payment Timing Schedule for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
The claim deadlines and payment timing of the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) are the same on every tier.

| Tier | Proof of loss due after date of loss (calendar days) | Payable after accepted proof of loss (calendar days) | Payable after adjuster's report signed in lieu (calendar days) | FEMA appeal window after denial (calendar days) | Suit limitation after denial (calendar months) | Adjuster contact standard (elapsed hours) | Mortgagee named on building payments |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 60 | 60 | 90 | 60 | 12 | 24 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 60 | 60 | 90 | 60 | 12 | 24 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 60 | 60 | 90 | 60 | 12 | 24 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 60 | 60 | 90 | 60 | 12 | 24 | yes |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 60 | 60 | 90 | 60 | 12 | 24 | yes |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 60 | 60 | 90 | 60 | 12 | 24 | yes |

- **Proof of loss — 60 calendar days.** A signed and sworn proof of loss must be received within 60 days after the date of loss.
- **Payment after proof of loss — 60 calendar days** after receipt of an accepted proof of loss.
- **Payment after an adjuster's report signed in lieu — 90 calendar days.**
- **Appeal — 60 calendar days** after the date of a written denial, to FEMA.
- **Suit — 12 calendar months** after the date of the written denial.
- **Adjuster contact — 24 elapsed hours**, Tidemark's servicing standard for the assigned adjuster to contact the insured after the claim is reported.
- **Mortgagee on building payments.** On every tier building claim payments are issued jointly to the insured and the mortgagee of record.

**Deadline illustration (hypothetical).** For a date of loss of 10 September, adding 60 days on the calendar gives 9 November as the last day a proof of loss can be received.

## Parameter meanings

- Days after the date of loss within which a signed and sworn proof of loss must be received; calendar days.
- Days after receipt of an accepted proof of loss within which the loss is payable; calendar days.
- Days after an adjuster's report signed by the insured in lieu of proof of loss within which the loss is payable; calendar days.
- Days after the date of a written denial within which the policyholder may appeal to FEMA; calendar days.
- Months after the date of the written denial within which suit must be filed; calendar months.
- Tidemark servicing standard for the assigned adjuster to contact the insured after the claim is reported; elapsed hours.
- Whether building claim payments are issued jointly to the insured and the mortgagee of record; boolean.
